impact.affected_asset: Access-control and exposure boundary of workspace sub-agent applications governed by Enterprise template port-sharing policy.
impact.attacker_capability: A workspace owner with an agent token can register a PUBLIC sub-agent app when the configured template maximum is less permissive.
impact.security_effect: Unauthorized exposure of a sub-agent application to unauthenticated users through wildcard app-domain routing, contrary to the template port-sharing policy.

causal_trace.summary: An authenticated workspace owner with an agent token submits CreateSubAgent registration containing a sub-agent app with a requested sharing level, such as PUBLIC.
Before the fix, CreateSubAgent did not compare the requested app sharing level with the workspace template's MaxPortSharingLevel.
The RPC persisted workspace apps using the unbounded requested sharing level, permitting a sharing level more permissive than the administrator-configured template maximum.

Where Enterprise port-sharing policy and wildcard app hostnames are enabled, an owner can register a PUBLIC sub-agent app despite an owner-only template maximum, exposing that app through the wildcard app domain to unauthenticated users.

failure.operation: Persisting a CreateSubAgent-requested workspace app sharing level without applying the template maximum.

primary_invariant.statement: Every persisted sub-agent workspace app sharing level must be no more permissive than the template's MaxPortSharingLevel.
primary_invariant.violated_because: CreateSubAgent persisted the caller-requested sharing level without validating it against MaxPortSharingLevel.

quality.review_notes: The vendor advisory explicitly identifies the pre-fix persistence behavior, required deployment conditions, and impact; the patch and enterprise regression-test source corroborate clamping and the stored-sharing-level oracle. The bundle contains no test-run output, so this record does not claim the regression test was executed. Exact pre-fix source-level control flow was not recovered from the rendered vulnerable-tree artifact, and the regression test covers Enterprise policy scope.

remediation.invariant_restored: The fix clamps each requested sub-agent app sharing level to the template's MaxPortSharingLevel before persistence.
mitigation_classes: template-policy enforcement at sub-agent app registration

target.component: coderd agentapi SubAgentAPI / CreateSubAgent sub-agent app registration

oracle.channel: enterprise Go regression test using the SubAgentAPI client path and database inspection
oracle.expected_negative: A stored PUBLIC sharing level is not permitted when the template maximum is authenticated.
oracle.expected_positive: With an authenticated maximum, a requested PUBLIC sub-agent app is stored with authenticated sharing; the test also specifies preservation of levels permitted by the maximum.
